description: Amreli Steels Limited, incorporated in 1984, manufactures steel reinforcement bars and billets at its plant in Dhabeji, Sindh. Its Maxima bars conform to ASTM A615 in sizes from 10 mm to 40 mm, and its Ultima bars to ASTM A706 for high-seismic zones; the company also produces bars to BS 4449:2005. Every heat is tested in its own laboratory with universal testing machines and metallographic analysis.
